title: "Visualise"
output: html_document

```{r Libraries}

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

```

```{r Read in Relevant Data}

# first aim of the game is to read in the set, and plot its first two PCs against each other to see what we got.
SET <- fread("D:/AlgorithmComparisonSim/BaseSim/set25")
TRUTH <- fread("D:/AlgorithmComparisonSim/BaseSim/set25true_labels")
PCAKMEANS <- fread("D:/AlgorithmComparisonSim/BaseSim/PK25")
LOUVAIN <- fread("D:/AlgorithmComparisonSim/BaseSim/LV25")
LEIDEN <- fread("D:/AlgorithmComparisonSim/BaseSim/LD25")

# we do a lil pre processing. first transpose it, which will mean our columns have low and zero variances. so we drop those that do. 
SET <- t(SET)
SET <- SET[, apply(SET, 2, var) != 0]

#now TRUTH has a weird format that we need to recover. 
TRUTH$true_group <- as.numeric(str_remove_all(TRUTH$true_group, "Group"))

#now Louvain has assignments 0-3 instead of 1-4
LOUVAIN$cluster <- LOUVAIN$cluster + 1


PCA <- prcomp(SET,
              center = TRUE,
              scale. = TRUE)
# PCA$rotation <- -1 * PCA$rotation
# PCA$x <- -1 * PCA$x

#plot(PCA$x[, 1], PCA$x[, 2])

plot_data <- tibble(
  X = PCA$x[, 1],
  Y = PCA$x[, 2],
  truth = TRUTH$true_group,
  pcakmeans = PCAKMEANS$cluster,
  louvain = LOUVAIN$cluster,
  leiden = LEIDEN$cluster
)

# Reshape data to long format for faceting
plot_data_long <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(truth, pcakmeans, louvain, leiden),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "cluster"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, 
                   levels = c("truth", "pcakmeans", "louvain", "leiden"),
                   labels = c("True Groups", "PCA K-means", "Louvain", "Leiden"))
  )

# Create faceted plot
ggplot(data = plot_data_long) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y, colour = factor(cluster)), alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    colour = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")

```
